summary: BioMar has awarded the Quitralco 7 farming operation in Chile its 2017 Farmer of the Year recognition. The award highlights the farm's performance and relationship with BioMar as a feed supplier and partner in aquaculture production standards.
title: Centro de cultivo Quitralco 7 es reconocido como "Biomar Farmer of the Year 2017"
